newsitem.title: FRANCE: SFP offers to go to French privatisation commission.
newsitem.headline: SFP offers to go to French privatisation commission.

text.p: The French government will pass on to the independent Privatisation Commission after September 30 the bids it has received in its sale of the SFP film and television production studio.

The Finance Ministry said in a statement on Friday that it received a firm offer from Global Studios and other candidates had emerged recently to buy Societe Francaise de Production. The time allowed for bids had now expired.
The offers will be examined by the Privatisation Commission and the European Commission and will be passed on to the SFP chairman who may disclose to the works committee.

The timetable should allow the employee committee to give its opinion on the offers before the final sale decision, which will be taken on the advice of the privatisation commission and the European Commission, the ministry statement said.

Global Studios is headed by French businessman Walter Butler, who has placed a 50 million franc bid for SFP, but wants a 1.2 billion franc state recapitalisation to cover restructuring, which includes shedding 667 out of a total 1,057 jobs. Belgian production house LB Convoi is also reported to be interested in SFP.
